### Adjust after the aliases are restored

- **B02 and B23** — In B02, combine your first and middle names in the order shown in your passport’s Given Names field. In B23, combine your wife’s first and family names into one full name in English.
- **B05, B15 and B30** — Convert both dates of birth to `yyyy/mm/dd`. Check the issue-date field for its required format and adjust the restored date by hand if needed.
- **B07** — Enter only the country from your restored birthplace. If the restored value gives only a locality, verify its country before completing the field.
- **B19 and B32** — I’ve used your home address for both fields because you currently live together in the UK. Verify that the restored address is your shared UK residence. Fill B19 only if it differs from B18.
- **B20 and B21** — I’ve assumed your listed phone number is your mobile. If it is your landline, move it to B21 and complete B20 with your mobile number.

### Complete the missing fields privately

| Field | What to supply or confirm |
|---|---|
| B03 | Your name in Hanja, if applicable. |
| B08 | Your national identity number, if applicable. |
| B09 | Whether you ever used another name to enter or leave Korea. If yes, enter the family and given names you used. |
| B10 | Whether you hold more than one citizenship. If yes, list the additional citizenships. |
| B11 | Your passport category. If it is Other, specify the type. |
| B14 | The place where your passport was issued. |
| B17 | Whether you hold another valid passport. If yes, supply its type, number, issuing country and expiry date. |
| B18 | Your home-country address in India, if you have one. If you have none, confirm how the form should record that. |
| B21–B22 | Your landline number, if you have one, and your email address. |
| B36–B37 | The institution that awarded your master’s degree in computer science and its city, province or equivalent, and country. |
| B39–B42 | Your employer’s name, your position, and the full office address and telephone number. Confirm with your employer whether to use the current office or the Seoul office for these fields. |
